title: NOVEL THREE- AND ONE-CARBON RING EXPANSION REACTIONS OF A FIVE MEMBERED CARBOCYCLIC COMPOUND
abstract: Abstract                Ethyl 2-oxo-1-(2-oxopropyl)-1-cyclopentanecarboxylate, on treatment with tBuOH-tBuOK at rt (1h), affords unusual ring expansion products ethyl 3,5-dioxo-1-cyclooctanecarboxylate, ethyl 4-acetyl-3-oxo-1-cyclohexanecarboxylate and ethyl 2-acetyl-3-oxo-1-cyclohexanecarboxylate in 19, 40 and 12% yields, respectively.
